text:
jordan: 12h till cutoff for v0.23. Quick sherpa: musts = bump, changelog, QA signoffs, security ok, docs publish. If you own something please reply with ETA. I'll freeze release branches at T-1h unless blockers. @devops-bot can you ping when CI fully green? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devops-bot: CI status update — main is green, release branch tests running (~60%). Will post final status when all gates pass.

maria: Taking version bump + changelog. Will open the PR in ~30m. CC @alex for a quick review.

alex: On it. I'll do a short pass on the changelog wording + deps. If anything risky I'll flag.

qa-lead: QA plan: smoke on staging in 3h, full regression overnight. Need sign-off on canary matrix by EOD. Critical flows I will validate: generation stability, streaming responses, embeddings pipeline.

security: Quick dependency audit done — Snyk shows a low sev vuln in a test fixture only. No prod blockers. I'll attach a brief audit note to the release when artifacts are up.

jordan: Great. Maria, ping when the PR is up. QA, can you add test IDs to the release checklist? I added a small helper to the checklist doc to paste IDs into.

maria: PR opened: 2812345900 — bump to v0.23.1 + changelog. Diff includes: - bump version - changelog entries - docs links fix. Command I used: ```git checkout -b release/bump-v0.23 && git commit -am 'chore: bump v0.23' && git push```

alex: Reviewed and approved; left minor wording nits. @maria feel free to ship once CI is green. :thumbsup: 

devops-bot: Release-branch CI: all checks passed. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/releases/v0.23.1

sam: Docs side — I'll do a quick publish to the docs site after the tag. ETA ~45m.

emily: Can we wait to send the external changelog/email until security summary is attached? Want to include the audit blurb.

security: Agreed. I'll drop the short summary within 30m and add it to the release notes.

qa-lead: :white_check_mark: Canaries passed on staging. Regression queue started.

jordan: Perfect — final plan: freeze in 1h unless a blocker surfaces. If anyone needs more time shout now.

maria: No blockers from my side.

alex: Same.

sam: Docs ready to publish on tag. Run: ```./scripts/publish_docs.sh v0.23.1``` after tag.

jordan: Tagging now. Tag: v0.23.1 — pushing tag.

devops-bot: Tag pushed and deployment pipeline started. Cutoff enforced.

qa-lead: Monitoring prod rollout smoke, will report back in ~20m.

jordan: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble a short post-release notes and follow up if anything needs a postmortem. :partyparrot:
